description: The card of a file change (lib/approval-preview.mjs): the bounds (20 files, 200 rows, 400 characters, 120,000 characters, 500 characters of a refusal), a line cut at a character and not inside one, the guard of every file of the call and the digest of the arguments, and the body of a private key hidden by its place in the old and the new text, judged by tests/verify-approval-preview.mjs. After the audit of PR #103: the key in one line, PGP's frames, the rows' keys hidden before they are cut. Second round of PR #103: the key machinery is one state machine (frames, parts, lines), shared by the masker, the card and the answer of edit_file.

mutations.name: AP-files-more
mutations.what: twenty-one files on the card

mutations.name: AP-rows-more
mutations.what: two hundred and one rows of a file

mutations.name: AP-row-chars-more

mutations.name: AP-chars-more

mutations.name: AP-canonical-sort

export const PRIVATE_KEY_END = String.raw`-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.name: AP-keys-ending

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-old

mutations.name: AP-keys-flag-new

mutations.name: AP-keys-old-text

patches.old: const newKeys = typeof plan.newText === 'string' ? keyLines(plan.newText) : NO_KEYS;

patches.old: files: plans.map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };
patches.new: files: plans.slice(0, PREVIEW_LIMITS.files).map((plan) => ({ path: plan.relative, baseSha: plan.baseSha })) };

mutations.name: AP-guard-tool

mutations.name: AP-guard-args

mutations.name: AP-guard-files

mutations.name: AP-hidden-files

mutations.name: AP-truncated-files

mutations.name: AP-rows-hidden
mutations.what: the rows that are not shown are not counted

mutations.what: a hunk that is cut does not say how much

mutations.name: AP-action-create

mutations.name: AP-keys-stray-end

mutations.name: AP-keys-first-frame

mutations.name: AP-keys-pgp-begin

patches.old: export const PRIVATE_KEY_BEGIN = String.raw`-----BEGIN [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.what: the END frame of a PGP private key is not recognised

patches.old: export const PRIVATE_KEY_END = String.raw`-----END [A-Z0-9 ]*PRIVATE KEY(?: BLOCK)?-----`;

mutations.name: AP-keys-fast-path
mutations.what: the line without the words PRIVATE KEY is not skipped at once
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: a line without the words has no frame, and the check after it gives the same answer

mutations.name: AP-inline-marker
mutations.what: the key in a row is cut out and nothing is put in its place

mutations.name: AP-inline-end-frame
mutations.what: the END frame of a key in a row is cut out with the key

mutations.name: AP-inline-nested
mutations.what: a BEGIN frame inside a key starts another key

mutations.name: AP-inline-no-break
mutations.what: every frame makes the text be read again from it (a megabyte of frames takes seconds)

patches.new: for (const frame of framesOf(text)) { text.indexOf('-----END', frame.end);

mutations.name: AP-inline-not-applied
mutations.what: the rows are cut to 400 characters before the key in them is hidden

patches.old: for (const row of hideKeyBodies(hunk, oldKeys, newKeys)) {
patches.new: for (const row of hideKeyBodies({ ...hunk, rows: hunk.rows.map(clipRow) }, oldKeys, newKeys)) {

mutations.name: AP-inline-row-kind
mutations.what: a row whose key material is hidden loses its kind

patches.old: if (text !== row.text) return { kind: row.kind, text };

mutations.name: AP-holds-body
mutations.what: a call is not told to touch a key when the key is over several lines

mutations.name: AP-holds-inline
mutations.what: a call is not told to touch a key when the key is in one line, or in a line that holds a frame

patches.old: for (const [index, open] of framed) if (hideKeyMaterial(lines[index], open) !== lines[index]) return true;

mutations.name: AP-holds-guard
mutations.what: holdsPrivateKey reads the lines of a text that does not say PRIVATE KEY
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: a text without the words has no frame, and the two checks after it give the same answer

mutations.name: AP-frames-begin
mutations.what: the BEGIN frames of a text are not looked for

patches.old: for (const match of text.matchAll(BEGIN_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: true, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });

mutations.name: AP-frames-end
mutations.what: the END frames of a text are not looked for

patches.old: for (const match of text.matchAll(END_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: false, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });

mutations.name: AP-frames-order
mutations.what: the frames are not put in the order they come in the text (the BEGIN frames, then the END frames)

mutations.name: AP-frames-kind-begin
mutations.what: a BEGIN frame is told to be an END frame

patches.old: for (const match of text.matchAll(BEGIN_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: true, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });
patches.new: for (const match of text.matchAll(BEGIN_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: false, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });

mutations.name: AP-frames-kind-end
mutations.what: an END frame is told to be a BEGIN frame

patches.old: for (const match of text.matchAll(END_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: false, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });
patches.new: for (const match of text.matchAll(END_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: true, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });

mutations.name: AP-frames-end-position
mutations.what: the end of a frame is where it starts

patches.old: for (const match of text.matchAll(BEGIN_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: true, start: match.index, end: match.index + match[0].length });
patches.new: for (const match of text.matchAll(BEGIN_FRAMES)) found.push({ begin: true, start: match.index, end: match.index });

mutations.name: AP-parts-body-start
mutations.what: the body of a key starts at its BEGIN frame (the frame is hidden with it)

mutations.name: AP-parts-closed
mutations.what: a key that begins and ends in the text is taken for the end of a key that began before

patches.old: parts.push({ kind: began ? 'closed' : 'head', start: from, end: Math.max(frame.start, from) });
patches.new: parts.push({ kind: false ? 'closed' : 'head', start: from, end: Math.max(frame.start, from) });

mutations.name: AP-parts-began
mutations.what: a key that begins in the text is not told so

mutations.name: AP-parts-stray-end
mutations.what: an END frame with no key open closes one

mutations.name: AP-parts-no-close
mutations.what: an END frame does not close a key

mutations.name: AP-parts-clamp
mutations.what: an END frame that shares its dashes with the BEGIN before it ends the key before it began (the text is written twice)

patches.old: parts.push({ kind: began ? 'closed' : 'head', start: from, end: Math.max(frame.start, from) });
patches.new: parts.push({ kind: began ? 'closed' : 'head', start: from, end: frame.start });

mutations.name: AP-parts-tail
mutations.what: a key with no END frame is not a part of the text

patches.old: if (open) parts.push({ kind: 'tail', start: from, end: text.length });
patches.new: if (false) parts.push({ kind: 'tail', start: from, end: text.length });

mutations.name: AP-parts-tail-end
mutations.what: the tail of a key with no END frame is empty

patches.old: if (open) parts.push({ kind: 'tail', start: from, end: text.length });
patches.new: if (open) parts.push({ kind: 'tail', start: from, end: from });

mutations.name: AP-hide-fast-path
mutations.what: a text without the words PRIVATE KEY is not returned at once
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: a text without the words has no frame, and with no body open the parts of it are none, so the text comes back all the same

mutations.name: AP-hide-fast-path-open
mutations.what: a text without the words PRIVATE KEY is returned at once also when a body is open (the line of a body is hidden)

mutations.name: AP-hide-closed-kind
mutations.what: a key that begins and ends in the text is not hidden

mutations.name: AP-hide-closed-from
mutations.what: the text before a key is lost

mutations.name: AP-hide-closed-resume
mutations.what: the text after a key is read again from the start of the key

mutations.name: AP-hide-closed-block
mutations.what: a key over several lines is hidden as if it were in one line (its frames are not on lines of their own)

mutations.name: AP-hide-edges
mutations.what: the head and the tail of a text are hidden also when the text is not read by lines (the masker hides the start of a key that goes on)

mutations.name: AP-hide-trailing-cr
mutations.what: the carriage return of a Windows line ending is a part of the tail

mutations.name: AP-hide-trailing-lf
mutations.what: the line feed at the end of the tail is a part of it

mutations.name: AP-hide-trailing-all
mutations.what: the line ending is a part of the tail

mutations.name: AP-hide-trailing-guard
mutations.what: the line ending is taken off the tail up to the start of the text (not up to the start of the tail)
mutations.equivalent: a guard that cannot be reached: a tail starts after the dash of its BEGIN frame, or at the start of the text, and never behind a line ending

mutations.name: AP-hide-no-head
mutations.what: a head that holds something (the end of a key that began on an earlier line) is not hidden

mutations.name: AP-hide-no-tail
mutations.what: a tail that holds something (the start of a key that goes on in the next line) is not hidden

mutations.name: AP-hide-blank
mutations.what: a part with only spaces in it is hidden

mutations.name: AP-hide-blank-trim
mutations.what: a part with only spaces in it is not blank

mutations.name: AP-hide-edge-before
mutations.what: the text before a head or a tail is lost

mutations.name: AP-hide-edge-resume
mutations.what: the text after a head is read again from the start of the head

mutations.name: AP-hide-edge-marker
mutations.what: the head and the tail are cut out and nothing is put in their place

mutations.name: AP-hide-rest
mutations.what: the text after the last part is lost

mutations.name: AP-export-blocks
mutations.what: hideKeyBlocks hides the edges too

patches.old: export const hideKeyBlocks = (text) => hideKeyParts(text, false, false);
patches.new: export const hideKeyBlocks = (text) => hideKeyParts(text, false, true);

mutations.name: AP-export-blocks-open
mutations.what: hideKeyBlocks starts with a body open

patches.old: export const hideKeyBlocks = (text) => hideKeyParts(text, false, false);
patches.new: export const hideKeyBlocks = (text) => hideKeyParts(text, true, false);

mutations.name: AP-export-material
mutations.what: hideKeyMaterial hides only the keys that begin and end in the line

patches.old: export const hideKeyMaterial = (line, open) => hideKeyParts(line, open, true);
patches.new: export const hideKeyMaterial = (line, open) => hideKeyParts(line, open, false);

mutations.name: AP-export-material-open
mutations.what: hideKeyMaterial does not know that a body was open

patches.old: export const hideKeyMaterial = (line, open) => hideKeyParts(line, open, true);
patches.new: export const hideKeyMaterial = (line, open) => hideKeyParts(line, false, true);

mutations.name: AP-keys-framed-open
mutations.what: the lines with a frame do not say whether a body was open where they began

mutations.name: AP-keys-framed-off
mutations.what: the lines with a frame are not told apart from the others

mutations.name: AP-keys-frame-in-body
mutations.what: a line with a frame is a line of a body when a body is open

mutations.name: AP-keys-lines
mutations.what: keyLines does not return the lines

mutations.name: AP-holds-open
mutations.what: holdsPrivateKey does not know that a body was open where a line began

patches.old: for (const [index, open] of framed) if (hideKeyMaterial(lines[index], open) !== lines[index]) return true;
patches.new: for (const [index, open] of framed) if (hideKeyMaterial(lines[index], false) !== lines[index]) return true;

mutations.name: AP-holds-changed
mutations.what: holdsPrivateKey takes a line with a frame for key material whether or not there is any in it

patches.old: for (const [index, open] of framed) if (hideKeyMaterial(lines[index], open) !== lines[index]) return true;
patches.new: for (const [index, open] of framed) if (hideKeyMaterial(lines[index], open) === lines[index]) return true;

mutations.name: AP-rows-framed
mutations.what: the rows that hold a frame are not looked at

mutations.name: AP-rows-framed-open
mutations.what: a row that holds a frame is cut without knowing that a body was open

mutations.name: AP-rows-body
mutations.what: the rows that are a line of a body are not looked at

mutations.name: AP-rows-place-removed
mutations.what: a removed row is placed by the number of the new text

mutations.name: AP-rows-place-added
mutations.what: an added row is placed by the number of the old text

mutations.name: AP-rows-unchanged
mutations.what: a row with a frame that has no key material in it is copied (the same row)
mutations.equivalent: the copy has the same kind and the same text as the row it was made from

patches.old: if (text !== row.text) return { kind: row.kind, text };

mutations.name: AP-rows-early-old
mutations.what: the rows are not looked at when the new text has no keys, whatever the old one has

patches.old: if (!oldKeys.framed.size && !newKeys.framed.size) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key
patches.new: if (!newKeys.framed.size) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key

mutations.name: AP-rows-early-new
mutations.what: the rows are not looked at when the old text has no keys, whatever the new one has

patches.old: if (!oldKeys.framed.size && !newKeys.framed.size) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key
patches.new: if (!oldKeys.framed.size) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key

mutations.name: AP-rows-early-return
mutations.what: the rows are copied one by one when the texts hold no key
mutations.equivalent: a speed-up: with no key in either text no row is a line of a body or holds a frame, and every row comes back as it is

patches.old: if (!oldKeys.framed.size && !newKeys.framed.size) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key
patches.new: if (false) return hunk.rows; // a body starts at a line with a frame: no such line, no key
